g.text: A longer averaging window dilutes the stall

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607286

g.text: Single RTX 4090 | Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct | Shared background history | 5 paired repeats

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607286

g.text: All panels use client token intervals and paired decode-only controls. Percent changes are computed per trial, then averaged; error bars = sample SD, n=5.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607286

g.text: Panels have different vertical scales. The first two use event-aligned windows; the last reproduces the existing whole-request TPOT metric.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #607286

g.text: All measured batch sizes are shown. Changing the window reveals the stall magnitude; it does not establish a full-versus-append separation.
